name: CSV Glossary Lookup
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Adds local CSV and TSV import with column mapping.
Adds exact term lookup, source senses, safe insertion, and manual reload.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
You can import a local CSV or TSV glossary and choose which columns to use.
Look up a selected term to see each of its meanings, then insert one in place of the selection.
tip: Turn off 'Ignore case' when capitalization changes a term's meaning.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. CSV Glossary Lookup is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your glossaries.
